cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Interpret the Custom
cards.instruction: Ask them to apply an ambiguous custom where the wording is unclear. Treat their interpretation as the real test of loyalty.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Before I leave for my shift, how much lasagne will you save me? Family custom says 'a proper portion.'

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Then I'll find out what 'proper' means when it's for me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Save mine before you serve those. I'd like being expected home to count before being hungry twice.

mechanism: A assumes authority to judge B loyalty through B interpretation of an ambiguous custom, treating proposed minimum compliance as an answer A can accept or reject.
confusable: D178 chooses a rule among rivals; D179 applies ambiguous wording within one custom and interprets the choice as personal loyalty.
comparison: Family portion tests whether an absent shift worker counts before seconds; allotment signature tests membership support against other members disapproval.
seedUse: Both full instructions and four canonical seeds read. Preserve proper portion and where possible ambiguities, avoiding conversion into a simple fixed rule or generic demand for obedience.
